facts.body: Canonical chat identity: Ivan is «на психопате»; he is accepted rather than fixed, including the «Плавленый сырник» self-description.
Canonical depiction: a bald bearded dwarf; «куа-енотик» is only a nickname.

Canonical chat identity: @Kukovjako and «Саня» are one person and one of «нормальных»; only Sanya can «запускать канаву», appears from it as «Застава Юго», and treats a respawn as a conscious tactical decision.
Canonical chat identity: Kazyan is «Рафаэль» and «пятый элемент», with meme bad Steam standing, no likes, and no awards.
Canonical chat fact: in Forza Horizon 6 Vhailor has a Renault Mégane RS, RJ Anderson #37 Polaris RZR Pro 4 Truck, and a silver 2021 Audi RS6.
Canonical chat identity: Smute burns in the sun, likes water, and says «я практически Иван».
Canonical chat identity: interested in hookah culture and prefers the Oblako M hookah bowl.
Canonical hookah setup: Wookah White Nox hookah with a Wookah Apis Crystal flask; uses an Oblako M bowl.
